Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: StellarTech POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed POC plan so we’re all aligned. Please reply with any corrections or outstanding prerequisites.

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Search relevance drift on customer support KB (current re-rank embeddings pipeline shows stale vectors).
- High per-request cost for conversational assistant at peak load (500 rps spikes).
- Data residency: logs and inference must remain in your VPC; no egress to public S3.

Primary goals for the 4-week POC:
1) Improve user-facing relevance (measured by NDCG@10) by +8-12% on the provided eval set.
2) Achieve 99th percentile latency <= 150ms for the assistant at a sustained throughput of 200 rps, and demonstrate autoscaling for bursts to 500 rps.
3) Demonstrate cost/reliability tradeoffs: target inference unit cost < $3 per 1k requests at POC profile.

Scope / deliverables:
- Redwood will deploy a Private POC cluster in your AWS account (VPC peering + customer-managed subnet).
- We'll onboard your prompt set (attached) and run the provided evals (see prompt buckets in the CSV).
- Weekly check-ins (Tuesdays, 30m) and a final demo with quantitative results and recommendations.

Owners & contacts:
- Marissa Cole (Redwood, AE) — POC lead, timelines, contract items.
- Dev Patel (Redwood, SE) — infra, VPC peering, model config, test harness.
- Alex Johnson / Priya Natarajan (StellarTech) — data access, technical reviewer, product sponsor.

Timeline (proposed):
- Apr 12: kick off infra & auth (VPC peering, service account, SAML metadata)
- Apr 14-20: ingest prompt set + baseline evals
- Apr 21-28: tuning (batching/quantization recommendations) + mid-point check-in
- May 3-7: final evals, report & recommendation deck

Access/setup required from StellarTech:
1) Create cross-account role/Service Principal and share ARNs (Dev can provide CFN snippet).
2) Provide sample eval dataset (anonymized) & prompt set CSV (attached).
3) Provide SAML metadata for SSO and IP allowlist for POC cluster.

Attachments: stellartech-poc-scope.pdf (POC scope + SOW), stellartech-prompt-set.csv (prompt buckets + evals).

Next steps (please confirm):
- Alex: confirm Apr 12 for infra kickoff and share role ARNs by EOD Monday.
- Priya: share anonymized eval dataset (S3 link) and legal point of contact for the MOA.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming we’re good to proceed on the timeline. A few quick clarifications:
- We can share the anonymized eval dataset by Monday (will upload to a pre-signed S3 link).
- I’ll have CloudOps create the cross-account role; should have the ARN for you by EOD Monday.
- Data residency: we need logs retained in our VPC for 90 days and audit logs shipped to our Splunk instance — can Redwood support that during the POC?

Also looping in Priya for legal/contract on the MOA. Priya — can you confirm who should receive the DocuSign?

On the MOA and scope: the latency target looks correct. For cost target, we’ll treat cost assessments as directional during POC.

Appreciate it — excited to get this moving.

—Alex

Thanks Marissa — tagging in a few technical notes and the CFN snippet for the cross-account role.

Technical checklist (Redwood SE):
- I’ll send a CloudFormation snippet for the IAM role by Monday morning — that will include least-privilege policies for S3 GetObject and KMS decrypt.
- For VPC peering: we need the subnet/CIDR ranges and the security group rules that allow port ranges for our inference nodes (I'll provide a recommended SG).
- Splunk forwarding: we can push audit logs to your Splunk collector over a private endpoint. Need collector IP and cert thumbprint.
- Prompt ingestion: please confirm CSV format matches attached schema (we included a sample in stellartech-prompt-set.csv).

Test harness notes:
- Please include a subset of 1k production queries for the baseline (anonymized).
- We'll run NDCG and latency sweeps with the baseline model and two optimized variants (8-bit quant + tuned batching).

I'll prepare a short runbook and share a Drive link after the role/ARN is posted.
